A '''stormtrooper''' was stationed in [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. When [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]], [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaped]] the planet to get away from Marek's former [[master]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] stormtrooper encountered the clone. Starkiller used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], causing him to leap to his [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="TFU2vg" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="TFU2c" /> The stormtrooper was in a walkway above the [[Timira City]] parade grounds when [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]], was attempting to [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escape]] the planet. Starkiller came across the stormtrooper, and, after having a brief [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the future in which he used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on another stormtrooper, he used that [[The Force/Legends|Force]] power on the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] on the walkway. Due to the mind trick, the stormtrooper leaped out of a [[Window/Legends|window]], committing [[Death/Legends|suicide]].<ref name="TFU2vg" />

==Personality and traits==
As a part of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the individual wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="TFU2vg" /> The [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] was a [[Brain/Legends|weak-minded]] individual, as was demonstrated by his susceptibility to the mind trick employed by Starkiller.<ref name="guide">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|There is nothing for you here.''"<br />"''I've got to get out of here!|Starkiller and the stormtrooper, in one of the many different randomly selected quotes for the mind trick Force power|<ref name="TFU2vg" />}}
The stormtrooper first appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', released on [[October 26]], [[2010]]. The incident where Starkiller finds the stormtrooper marks the first instance in the game where the mind trick&mdash;a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that is used throughout the rest of the game&mdash;is employed. The game's [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II: Prima Official Game Guide|strategy guide]] includes the mind trick scenario in its walkthrough. The guide also calls the trooper "weak-minded." There are multiple things that Starkiller can say when using mind trick, all of which are game mechanics and are randomly selected.
